card.name: Words leading up to "career" in biographies
card.fires_on: Words in biographical sketches that come just before the noun "career", such as "long and distinguished", "a", or "forty-two year". It also fires on "career" itself when it follows "distinguished".

modes.label: Praise before career
modes.description: The adjective "distinguished" (or a similar one) describing a person's working life.
modes.example: HOST: Dr. Thomas Lovejoy of the United States has enjoyed a long and d<<istinguished>> career having served as the Chief Biod

modes.label: Career word itself
modes.description: The word "career" after an adjective or possessive in a biography.
modes.example: In this regard, Jim Horton, now retired after a distinguished<< career>> as a botanist at Western Carolina

modes.label: Articles and numbers before career
modes.description: Small words like "a" or a length of time that set up an upcoming "career".
modes.example: Flanigen began<< a>> forty-two year career in research at Union

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about a whole working life, such as lifetime, careers and 生涯.
card.plain: It spots biographies where the next word is likely to be "career" or "lifetime".
